scope: Read-only local service calls; no HTTP/browser/load/concurrency measurement
timing_method: One warmup (the structural sample) plus three lighter timing samples; fresh context/session each call; DB buffers are warm, frontend cache bypassed
db_bytes_method: Sum UTF-8 size of buffered DBAPI cell values; excludes protocol overhead; rows/bytes include repeated metadata/state reads, not distinct Notes or rows examined
clock_method: Browse service clock frozen; downstream helpers not explicitly patched may use real time
